faq.q: How much does Cohan Law Firm charge?
faq.a: Cohan Law Firm publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Cohan Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Cohan Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation. It publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Cohan Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: Cohan Law Firm publishes two offices, in Manhattan and Brooklyn. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Cohan Law Firm?
faq.a: Cohan Law Firm names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: Are the case results Cohan Law Firm publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Cohan Law Firm publishes 22 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Cohan Law Firm?
faq.a: Cohan Law Firm scores 64 and sits at Listed. Passed: footprint. Did not pass: entity registration and website. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.

score.verdict: 1 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 3 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2, G3) and do not count against the firm.
